port_changes: Native StrictStructuredOutput replaces research-only Model; extra=forbid and all field constraints preserved.
Compilation returns an explicit dataclass instead of a research Plan plus tuple.
Only selected bundle representation is retained; alternate research strategies, transport and filesystem materialization are excluded.
New-script original-byte validation is colocated with compilation instead of a wrapper.
Code annotations and native exceptions replace research imports; generation/review semantics and prompt bytes retained.

Read-only native-incumbent compatibility: strict canonical decode first; stale length framing can be read only when the original valid manifest and uniquely located ordered section markers partition the whole body. Stored content/digests/resources are never rewritten by this read view. New outputs remain strictly canonical.

Configured single-tool CLI/OpenClaw ladders carry all original typed declarations and terminal completion in one inert return_procedural_batch; mixed ladders use the same envelope before capacity admission. Network-only measured MiniMax delivery remains unchanged. Qualified Claude models use compatible automatic tool selection with strict terminal validation; structural repair retains shared signed/encrypted provider continuation metadata.

Native source text and 600-character quotation slices preserve every original character and boundary, including whitespace-only pieces. These are raw evidence addresses, not approved guidance: instruction/resource text remains nonblank, and an entirely blank visible native window is a retained NOOP with the original source witnesses preserved.

Exhausted outer-batch JSON normalizes to a terminal content-free ContractError after one structural repair, retained by both stage journals. Effective per-stage native request policy and every fallback rung are bound by SHA-256 in checkpoint contracts and step keys; raw request descriptors and credential-bearing route URLs are never retained.
